question.text: At any point in time, how many monthly equity derivative contracts are available for trading?

answer.text: Three — near month, next month, and far month
One — only the current month's contract
Six — contracts for the next six months
Twelve — contracts for the next twelve months

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 204, at any time three monthly contracts are available to trade — near month, next month and far month — and the same page describes the broader contract cycle with quarterly and semi-annual contracts also available. The Trap: One-month-only, six-month or twelve-month framings do not match the three-contract cycle the workbook describes; when the near month expires, a new far-month contract is introduced. Note: Use the near-month, next-month, far-month structure when explaining which contracts are open at any given time.
